Guild Boss

Guild members take turns on the Guild Boss. Your damage earns Conquer Points and daily rewards.

RewardsConquer PointsDaily rewardsGuild Activeness

How it works

  • Open once you join a guild. Each challenge costs 1 Guild Boss Stamina, refilled to max at 02:00 (UTC+0) daily.
  • Rewards and Conquer Points scale with the damage you deal. Reach the Conquer Point goal to unlock a higher-level Guild Boss.
  • Daily challenge rewards arrive in your Reward Box at 02:00 (UTC+0) the next day.
  • Battle Test lets you try lineups without spending stamina (no rewards, no ranking).
  • Raid (quick clear) unlocks for a difficulty once a single challenge hits the damage cap.
